title: HealthObservation
description: One time-bounded observation of a provider's or engine instance's operational health (ADR-SHARED-007 §37, ADR-BCP-006). Health is an observation, not a fact: it is valid only from observed_at until expires_at. A consumer that holds no observation, or only an expired one, treats the subject's health as UNKNOWN. How UNKNOWN affects eligibility is health-policy.yaml's rule. Health stays separate from provider lifecycle.

observed_at.description: When the observation was made, not when it was recorded.

expires_at.description: After this instant the observation says nothing, and the subject's health is UNKNOWN until a newer one arrives. Must be later than observed_at.

reasons.description: Registered codes explaining the status. Empty only for HEALTHY.

healthSubject.description: What was observed: a provider, one engine instance, or one engine instance serving a provider. At least one identifier is required.
